ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-23-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo, CSR: Janet Pond.
Petitioner Rocio Ortiz and Fernando Alvarez, Jr. present with minor in pro per.
Parties were sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to : Santino Rocendo Alvarez.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-04-2003 Reset To Dec-23-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for change of name for a minor this day.
Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V. Mack, CSR: Valerie Papale.
Petitioner, Rocio Ortiz present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
Petition is lacks signature by the minor's father.
Matter is continued to Dec. 23, 2003 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
